decisive_items: heliotrope rash and erythematous lip swelling
positive myositis panel for anti-SAE antibodies
Skin biopsy results were consistent with Wong-type presentation
response.rationale: Dermatomyositis is supported by characteristic rash (heliotrope), proximal weakness, elevated CK, anti-SAE antibodies, and Wong-type biopsy. Polymyositis lacks the rash; Sjögren's is only suggested by anti-SSA without sicca symptoms.

rejected.why: No skin rash or anti-SAE; polymyositis does not explain the dermatologic findings.
Anti-SSA is nonspecific and no sicca symptoms; other features point to myositis.
